{{Top|leg}}
'''Galasol Strip''' was a wide avenue located near the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. It was framed on either side by a collection of overpriced casinos and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].
